name: Seikimatsu Taimaden Tsumugi-chan SOS
original_name: 世紀末退魔伝つむぎちゃん SOS
source:
Tsumugi-chan is a girl from a demonic master clan who lives in a mountain temple. While still being inexperienced, a difficult job came in for her one day - to investigate the seven wonders of the school and eliminate the evil contained there. An apprentice exorcist and psychic who can not control her abilities will help Tsumugi-chan to uncover the mystery hidden in the school!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Based on the H-manga of the same name by Tokaidow Micty (東海道みっちい).
translation:
紬酱是住在山寺里的魔族大师族的少女。正当她还没有经验的时候，有一天，一项艰巨的工作降临到了她的身上——调查学园的七大奇迹，并消除其中蕴藏的邪恶。无法控制自己能力的驱魔师和通灵学徒将帮助小紬揭开隐藏在学校里的谜团！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

改编自东海道みっちい的同名H漫画。
